description: Declarative, file-agnostic context bundling configuration for packaging RFC-LLM source code, executables, tests, domain knowledge, and architectural specifications into plain-text Markdown bundles optimized for Gemini and LLM Notebook ingestion.

bundles.name: 00_ARCHITECTURE_AND_INDEX.md
bundles.title: RFC-LLM Master Index, Architecture & Project Configuration
bundles.description: Tier 1 — Master repository index, executive Gemini ingestion guide, delta changelog since last sync, automated AST symbol and CLI script registry, heavy/binary asset inventory, architecture specifications, and root project configuration manifests.

bundles.name: 01_CORE_SOURCE_AND_CLI.md
bundles.title: RFC-LLM Core Source Code, Compilers, IR & CLI Entrypoints
bundles.description: Tier 2 — Complete core synthesis and Phase 3 <think> curation pipeline (`src/` and `prompts/`), including YAML-frontmatter prompt templates, RFC document ingestion, order-sorted message algebra intermediate representation (IR), constrained protocol extraction, CPSA 4.4.9 JSON/Scheme code generation, roletran & compiler self-healing verification engine, trajectory & quality-tier exporter, DSPy hindsight `<think>` synthesizer (`src/generate_think/`), virtualized multi-RFC web visualizer, root `rfc-llm` and `rfc-think` CLI entrypoints, and the benchmark EDHOC input RFC.
bundles.tier: Tier 2 — Core Source Code & CLI Entrypoints

bundles.name: 02_RAG_SCRIPTS_AND_TESTS.md
bundles.title: CPSA Knowledge Base TOC & Pytest Verification Suites
bundles.description: Tier 3 — Master CPSA 4.4.9 Knowledge Base Table of Contents (`refrences/cpsa_kb/TOC.md`) with `rebuild_toc` YAML flag, and the complete pytest unit and integration test suite (`tests/`).
bundles.tier: Tier 3 — Knowledge Base Index & Test Suites

bundles.name: 03_CPSA_DOMAIN_KNOWLEDGE_AND_GUIDES.md
bundles.title: CPSA 4.4.9 Core Rules, Compiler Diagnostics & Official Manuals
bundles.description: Tier 1/3 Domain Reference — Zero-hallucination CPSA 4.4.9 core operational rules (`refrences/cpsa_kb/01_core_rules/`), JSON AST to Scheme S-expression mapping, exhaustive compiler/solver diagnostic catalog, and the 5 consolidated official MITRE manuals (`refrences/cpsa_kb/02_manuals/`).
bundles.tier: Tier 1/3 — Domain Reference Documentation & Modeling Guides

bundles.name: 04_CPSA_SCM_EXAMPLES_CORPUS.md
bundles.title: Official MITRE CPSA Scheme (.scm) Protocol Examples & Catalog (151 Files)
bundles.description: Tier 3 Reference Corpus — Complete collection of all 151 official MITRE CPSA 4.4.9 `.scm` protocol specifications (`refrences/cpsa_kb/03_examples_scm/`) and their structured A-to-Z concept catalogs (`refrences/cpsa_kb/04_examples_catalog/*.md`).

summarized_assets.description: Tier 4 — Heavy, binary, compiled or JSON index artifacts excluded from raw text dumping and summarized with metadata, line/record counts, and lightweight schema previews.
